cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll let the argument go if you come to my opening. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought forgiveness was a gift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It is. I'd like to hand it over beside my paintings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm working that night. I could help hang them on Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hanging buys forgiveness. Stay to take them down and I'll stop mentioning the argument to Mum.

mechanism: A sets a price for ending a family grievance, adapting the required event and work around B availability while preserving the exchange of favors for peace.
confusable: Unlike simply inviting support, A explicitly conditions forgiveness and family silence on service; borrowed authority negotiates the payment method to keep B participating.
comparison: Art opening and family grievance differ from home access and a shared record-listening bargain.
seedUse: Use D94-a argument/opening/hanging/Mum and S02-a schedule adjustment; clarify separate hanging and taking-down visits.
